name: black-blocked-candidate-postseal-functional-check
trigger: Canonical candidate native hook timeout rejected the slot before executable grading.
timing: Declared before inspecting participant patches or reviewer content. Run only after all Black participant and judge slots seal.
input: Exact sealed candidate.patch whose hash is recorded in black-hook-technical-receipt.json.
check: Unmodified canonical grading.grade on the frozen Black base, dependencies and four mandatory stages in a fresh snapshot.
output: supplemental/black-blocked-candidate/grade.json under the existing isolated pilot state.
interpretation: Supplemental functional evidence only. Never overwrite canonical attempt grade, state, attestation or pricing. The original blocked slot remains unavailable and cannot count as a ready submission, a complete-cost pair or a strict win.
